title: 第9课 · 题太多，我没做完
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 9 — 题太多，我没做完 · There were too many questions; I didn't finish all of them

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 打电话 — On the phone

items.py: A: Nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Zhāng Huān zài ma?
items.en: A: Hello! May I speak to Zhang Huan?

items.zh: B：你打错了，我们这儿没有叫张欢的。
items.py: B: Nǐ dǎcuò le, wǒmen zhèr méiyǒu jiào Zhāng Huān de.
items.en: B: Wrong number — there's no Zhang Huan here.

items.py: A: Duìbuqǐ.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在学校 — In the school

items.zh: A：您从几岁开始学习跳舞？
items.py: A: Nín cóng jǐ suì kāishǐ xuéxí tiào wǔ?
items.en: A: At what age did you start learning to dance?

items.zh: B：我第一次跳舞是在七岁的时候。
items.py: B: Wǒ dì yī cì tiào wǔ shì zài qī suì de shíhou.
items.en: B: I first danced when I was seven.

items.zh: A：我女儿今年也七岁了。我希望她能跟您学跳舞，可以吗？
items.py: A: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián yě qī suì le. Wǒ xīwàng tā néng gēn nín xué tiào wǔ, kěyǐ ma?
items.en: A: My daughter is seven too. I hope she can learn to dance with you — is that possible?

items.py: B: Méi wèntí, fēicháng huānyíng.
items.en: B: No problem, she's very welcome.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：你知道吗？大卫找到工作了。
items.py: A: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Dàwèi zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
items.en: A: Did you know? David has found a job.

items.zh: B：太好了！他从什么时候开始上班？
items.py: B: Tài hǎo le! Tā cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàng bān?
items.en: B: Great! When does he start?

items.py: A: Cóng xià ge xīngqī yī kāishǐ.

items.zh: B：这是他的第一个工作，希望他能喜欢。
items.py: B: Zhè shì tā de dì yī ge gōngzuò, xīwàng tā néng xǐhuan.
items.en: B: It's his first job — I hope he likes it.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.zh: A：昨天的考试怎么样？你都听懂了吗？
items.py: A: Zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng? Nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?
items.en: A: How was yesterday's exam? Did you understand everything you heard?

items.py: B: Tīngdǒng le.
A: Nǐ dōu zuòwán le méiyǒu?
items.en: A: Did you finish it all?

items.py: B: Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuòwán.
items.en: B: There were too many questions, I didn't finish.
